According to Pew's 2025 data, around 73.6% of the world adheres to at least one of the five major world religions, while the remaining 26.4% is
religiously unaffiliated
or practicing
folk traditions
, represented by 1,908,590,000 being unaffiliated at 24.2%, and 170,000,000 participating in other practices having a share of 2.2%.
